questions.question: During the driving test, what should you do at a railroad crossing?

options.text: Pass another vehicle on the tracks if it is going too slow.
Get out of the vehicle to check for a train.
Do not change gears while on the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not change gears while on the tracks.
questions.explanation: During the driving test, do not stop, change gears, pass another vehicle, or change lanes while any part of your vehicle is on the railroad tracks.

questions.question: During the driving test, how should you make a lane change?

options.text: You do not need to worry about other drivers.
Use your turn signal and change lanes when it is safe.
Change lanes as quickly as possible, even if you cut off another driver.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your turn signal and change lanes when it is safe.
questions.explanation: When making a lane change during the driving test, check your mirrors, use your turn signal, and smoothly change lanes when it is safe.

questions.question: When loading or unloading passengers, where should a school bus be placed if there is no park position?

options.text: Reverse
First gear
Neutral

questions.correctAnswerText: Neutral
questions.explanation: When stopping to load or unload students, place a school bus in park if available. If park is not available, place it in neutral and set the parking brake.

questions.question: When exiting a vehicle, what should a driver do?

options.text: Jump directly from the seat to the ground.
Keep at least one hand on the vehicle.
Face toward the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Face toward the vehicle.
questions.explanation: When exiting your vehicle during the basic vehicle control skills test, face the vehicle and keep three points of contact at all times. If it is a bus, hold the handrail. Exiting incorrectly may cause you to fail the test.

questions.question: What is a passive railroad crossing?

options.text: A crossing with control devices.
A crossing with no control devices.
A crossing you should avoid.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossing with no control devices.
questions.explanation: A passive railroad crossing has no traffic control devices. It is up to the driver to decide if it is safe to cross.

questions.question: When approaching a school bus stop, what should the driver do?

options.text: Honk the horn.
Drive slowly.
Talk to students on the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive slowly.
questions.explanation: A school bus driver should always approach bus stops slowly and carefully.

questions.question: If a railroad crossing gate does not go up after a train passes, what should you do?

options.text: Drive around the gate.
Wait for another vehicle to cross first to see if it is safe.
Call your dispatcher.

questions.correctAnswerText: Call your dispatcher.
questions.explanation: If a gate fails to go up after a train passes, call your dispatcher. Do not try to drive around the lowered gate.

questions.question: Where should your vehicle be at the end of a basic vehicle control skills test exercise?

options.text: In the general area described by the examiner.
In the exact position described by the examiner.
Within three feet of the position described by the examiner.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the exact position described by the examiner.
questions.explanation: Your vehicle must be in the exact position described by the examiner when you finish each exercise. Not following instructions exactly may result in failing the test.

questions.question: What is an encroachment during the basic skills test?

options.text: A driver does not show up for their scheduled test.
A vehicle touches a boundary line during the test.
A driver fails one section of the test.

questions.correctAnswerText: A vehicle touches a boundary line during the test.
questions.explanation: An encroachment happens when any part of your vehicle touches or crosses a boundary line. Each encroachment counts as an error.

questions.question: When checking the fifth wheel gap during a pre-trip inspection, what should you look for?

options.text: A gap between the kingpin and the locking jaws.
The locking jaws fully closed around the kingpin.
The locking jaws are loose.

questions.correctAnswerText: The locking jaws fully closed around the kingpin.
questions.explanation: When inspecting the fifth wheel, make sure the locking jaws are fully closed around the kingpin.

questions.question: Before picking up students, when should a driver open the door and signal students to approach?

options.text: After all surrounding traffic has stopped.
After turning on the alternating red lights.
After pulling over to the side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: After all surrounding traffic has stopped.
questions.explanation: A school bus driver must make sure all traffic around the bus has stopped before opening the door and signaling students to board.

questions.question: What is true about loading and unloading a bus?

options.text: It can be dangerous for passengers.
It does not need anyone watching.
It should happen while refueling.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can be dangerous for passengers.
questions.explanation: More students are hurt or killed loading or unloading school buses than while riding in them. Drivers must follow safety rules during these times.

questions.question: During the vehicle inspection test, you must check all of the following, except:

options.text: The power steering belt.
The water compressor belt.
The alternator belt.

questions.correctAnswerText: The water compressor belt.
questions.explanation: During the pre-trip inspection, you will check the power steering, water pump, alternator, and air compressor belts if the vehicle has them. There is no water compressor belt to check.

questions.question: During the vehicle inspection test, you must be able to do all of the following, except:

options.text: Show where the dipstick is located.
Show that the engine oil is at a safe level.
Show that the oil is below the refill mark.

questions.correctAnswerText: Show that the oil is below the refill mark.
questions.explanation: During the pre-trip inspection, you will show where the dipstick is and prove the oil level is safe and above the refill mark. The oil should never be below the refill mark.

questions.question: If a driver must leave a school bus to check on students boarding, what should the driver do?

options.text: Leave the bus running.
Turn off the bus and take the key.
Ask a student to watch the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off the bus and take the key.
questions.explanation: If students are boarding and you cannot see all of them, secure the bus by turning it off and taking the key. Then check around and under the bus for any missing students.

questions.question: Where is the overhead rearview mirror located?

options.text: On the outside left of the bus.
On the outside right of the bus.
Above the windshield inside the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Above the windshield inside the bus.
questions.explanation: The overhead rearview mirror in a school bus is mounted above the windshield on the driver's side.

questions.question: What happens if you exit your vehicle incorrectly during the basic vehicle control skills test?

options.text: You fail only that exercise.
You lose extra points on your final score.
You automatically fail the entire test.

questions.correctAnswerText: You automatically fail the entire test.
questions.explanation: When exiting your vehicle, you must face the vehicle and hold on with three points of contact. On a bus, hold the handrail. Exiting incorrectly means you automatically fail the basic control skills test.

questions.question: What do crossover mirrors help the driver see?

options.text: The danger zones in front of the bus.
The rear bumper.
The left side of the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: The danger zones in front of the bus.
questions.explanation: Crossover mirrors help drivers see the danger zone directly in front of a school bus. They also show danger zones on the left and right sides, from the front of the bus to the service door.

questions.question: What are active railroad crossings?

options.text: Crossings with traffic control devices installed.
Crossings with no traffic control devices.
Crossings with at least 10 vehicles every hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: Crossings with traffic control devices installed.
questions.explanation: Active railroad crossings have control devices like flashing red lights, bells, and gates to manage traffic. Drivers must follow all instructions from these control devices.

questions.question: What will the examiner score you on during the driving test?

options.text: Your attitude.
How fast you reach your destination.
Your overall driving behavior.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your overall driving behavior.
questions.explanation: During the on-road driving test, the examiner scores you on specific driving maneuvers and your general driving behavior.
